parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the refraction of light passing through a transparent block. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 4.1. Fig. 4.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Place the transparent block, largest face down, on the ray-trace sheet supplied. The block should be approximately in the middle of the paper. Draw the outline of the block ABCD .

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Remove the block and draw a normal NL at the centre of side AB . Label the point E where the normal crosses AB . Label the point M where the normal crosses CD .

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Draw a line GH , parallel to AB and 6.0 cm above AB . Label the point J where the normal crosses GH .

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Draw a line, starting at E , to the left of the normal and at an angle of incidence i = 30° to the normal as shown in Fig. 4.1. Label the point F where the line meets GH .

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Place two pins P 1 and P 2 on the line FE , placing one pin close to E . Label the positions of P 1 and P 2 .

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Replace the block and observe the images of P 1 and P 2 through side CD of the block so that the images of P 1 and P 2 appear one behind the other. Place two pins P 3 and P 4 between your eye and the block so that P 3 and P 4 , and the images of P 1 and P 2 seen through the block, appear one behind the other. Label the positions of P 3 and P 4 . Remove the block.

parts.label: g
parts.text: (g) Draw a line joining the positions of P 3 and P 4 . Continue the line until it meets CD and label this point K . Draw the line KE .

parts.label: i
parts.text: (h) (i) Measure and record the length a between points F and J . a = ...............................................................

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Measure and record the length b between points F and E . b = ...............................................................

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Measure and record the length c between points E and K . c = ...............................................................

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Measure and record the length d between points M and K . d = ............................................................... [2]

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Calculate n , the refractive index of the material of the block, using the equation n = ac bd . n = .......................................................... [1]
